summary.intent: Push a lint fix to PR #485, diagnose why the original lint violation slipped past commit hooks, then resolve all 6 open CodeRabbit review comments on the PR.
summary.outcome: Lint fix pushed and CI went green; root cause of hook bypass confirmed (GSD/Entire executor uses --no-verify-style bypass). All 6 CodeRabbit threads resolved with fixes across 10 files; all tests and typecheck passed and the fix commit landed.

repo: GSD/Entire automated commit executor bypasses husky pre-commit hooks (--no-verify style) to prevent the auto-fixer from mutating files mid-run and desyncing atomic-commit state — CI eslint is the actual backstop for automated commits.
vitest in apps/web only includes **/*.test.ts, not **/*.spec.ts — any .spec.ts file in apps/web is silently excluded from CI test runs.
openapi:generate (ts-node script) must be followed by the prettier lint-fix step to match the committed openapi.json format; running generation alone produces a 714-line formatting-only diff.
The check-api-client.sh pre-commit hook blocks only if openapi.json has actual uncommitted changes — spec-neutral controller edits don't trigger it.
CI Typecheck job runs pnpm typecheck which only covers apps/web (tsc -b) and shared packages — api spec files are excluded.
Production environment gating convention is NODE_ENV === 'production' (not a dev-only check), as established in throttler-bypass.guard.ts.
AbortSignal.timeout() is the established timeout pattern — used in migration.processor.ts.

code.finding: guardedUnpin has two callers: line 126 is an internal rollback path (should suppress audit), line 149 is the /unpin endpoint (should emit audit). Adding an optional options param is safe.
Advisory-lock ordering test checks hashtext before pg_advisory_xact_lock in its mock branches — merging the two queries required reordering the mock to match the combined SQL.
fetchQuota had 5 callers, mostly fire-and-forget. Making it reject would cause unhandled-rejection blast radius; safer fix was returning a success boolean instead.
This file was the only .spec.ts in apps/web and was never executed by CI or local vitest due to the *.test.ts include glob. It was renamed to .test.ts as part of this session.
Controller spec asserted exact guardedUnpin call arguments — required updating after the suppress-audit options param was added to the rollback call path.

workflow: Verify vitest/jest include globs before assuming a spec file is being run — naming convention mismatches silently exclude tests.
Check blast radius of shared method signature changes (all callers, all test mocks) before implementing to avoid cascading test failures.
When touching a NestJS controller, run openapi:generate with its full pipeline (including lint-fix) to avoid cosmetic-only diffs that block the pre-commit hook check.
zsh does not word-split variables for command arguments — use xargs or quote glob patterns explicitly when passing file lists to tools like eslint or grep --include.

friction: zsh glob expansion silently ate --include patterns in the first grep blast-radius check, requiring a rerun with quoted globs.
zsh variable word-splitting prevented passing a file list directly to eslint — required xargs.

openapi:generate produced a spurious 714-line diff (formatting only) because the standalone generation step omits the prettier lint-fix that the full api:generate runs — required manual investigation and revert before committing.
delete.service.spec.ts had never executed despite being a PR deliverable — only discovered when explicitly checking vitest include globs.
open_items: Pre-existing TypeScript error in apps/api/src/ipfs/http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts (NestJS version export mismatch, introduced in #481) — outside CI typecheck scope but unresolved.
GSD/Entire executor's pre-commit hook bypass is a known architectural gap — CI lint is the only backstop for automated commits, with no local-hook coverage.
